description: List posts, pages or another post type, newest first. Returns ID, title, status, excerpt and link for each, without the full content. Filter by post_type, post_status, search text, author (user ID or slug) or a date range. Returns 10 items unless limit is set; page with offset or paged.

author__not_in.description: Exclude posts by these author user IDs.

author_name.description: Filter by author user slug (nicename). Ignored if author is set.

name: wp_get_posts
title: List posts
